description: Source code for a DID (Decentralized Identifier) management service in Go, handling DID creation, resolution, registration, partial updates, deregistration, and backfilling for agent nodes, reasoners, and skills within a registry system.

classes.name: DIDService
classes.description: Service class managing DID operations including creation, resolution, registration, partial updates, deregistration, and backfill for agent nodes, reasoners, and skills.

methods.name: NewDIDService
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of the DIDService.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DID service, including creating a master seed and root DID if necessary.

methods.name: GetAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Returns the current agent field server ID, resolving dynamically.

methods.name: getAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Internal helper to get the agent field server ID.

methods.name: validateAgentFieldServerRegistry
methods.description: Ensures that the DID registry for the agent server exists.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves a DID registry for a specified agent server ID.

methods.name: RegisterAgent
methods.description: Registers a new agent node with DIDs for the agent, reasoners, and skills, or updates existing DIDs if needed.

methods.name: handleNewRegistration
methods.description: Handles registration logic for new agents.

methods.name: resolveDID
methods.description: Resolves a DID to its associated identity data, regenerating keys as needed.

methods.name: generateDIDWithKeys
methods.description: Generates a new DID with its key pair based on a master seed and derivation path.

methods.name: generateDIDFromSeed
methods.description: Creates a DID from a master seed and a specified derivation path.

methods.name: derivePrivateKey
methods.description: Derives an Ed25519 private key from a master seed and derivation path.

methods.name: generateDIDKey
methods.description: Creates a DID:key string from an Ed25519 public key.

methods.name: ed25519PrivateKeyToJWK
methods.description: Converts an Ed25519 private key to a JSON Web Key (JWK) representation.

methods.name: ed25519PublicKeyToJWK
methods.description: Converts an Ed25519 public key to a JWK.

methods.name: hashAgentFieldServerID
methods.description: Creates a hash of the agent server ID for derivation path purposes.

methods.name: regeneratePrivateKeyJWK
methods.description: Regenerates a private key JWK from the master seed and derivation path.

methods.name: regeneratePublicKeyJWK
methods.description: Regenerates a public key JWK from the master seed and derivation path.

methods.name: ListAllAgentDIDs
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered agent DIDs.

methods.name: BackfillExistingNodes
methods.description: Backfills DIDs for existing nodes in storage that lack DIDs.

methods.name: GetExistingAgentDID
methods.description: Retrieves existing DID info for a specified agent node.

methods.name: PerformDifferentialAnalysis
methods.description: Compares current and new reasoners/skills to identify additions, removals, and updates.

methods.name: setDifference
methods.description: Helper to compute elements in one slice not in another.

methods.name: setIntersection
methods.description: Helper to compute common elements between slices.

methods.name: extractReasonerIDs
methods.description: Extracts reasoner IDs from reasoner definitions.

methods.name: extractSkillIDs
methods.description: Extracts skill IDs from skill definitions.

methods.name: findReasonerByID
methods.description: Finds a reasoner definition by its ID.

methods.name: findSkillByID
methods.description: Finds a skill definition by its ID.

methods.name: generateReasonerPath
methods.description: Generates a derivation path for a reasoner.

methods.name: generateSkillPath
methods.description: Generates a derivation path for a skill.

methods.name: buildExistingIdentityPackage
methods.description: Constructs an identity package for existing agent, reasoners, and skills.

methods.name: handlePartialRegistration
methods.description: Handles partial updates for existing agent registrations, including deregistration and new component registration.

methods.name: PartialRegisterAgent
methods.description: Registers only new components (reasoners, skills) for an existing agent.

methods.name: DeregisterComponents
methods.description: Deregisters specific components (reasoners, skills) from an agent.
